title: 10th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/10/1/2025).

Written question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister of Economic Development and Trade Mohamed Saeed: under the China-Maldives Free Trade Agreement, will duty be charged on tobacco products and cigarettes imported from China, how much state revenue will be lost as a result, and what is being done to cover the gap?

Written question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister Mohamed Saeed: the minister claimed FTA duty cuts would make goods much cheaper (for example MVR 500,000 to 600,000 saved on a MVR 5 million guesthouse); how much import-duty revenue will the state lose in each of the FTA's first five years, and why has the government still not published the FTA text?

Written question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister Mohamed Saeed: what import duties does the China-Maldives FTA set for skipjack and yellowfin tuna imported raw, frozen, processed or canned?

Written question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister Mohamed Saeed: the FTA's duty rates on tobacco and cigarettes appear to differ from the rates published by Maldives Customs Service; what are the FTA rates, and if Customs charges differently, what are the differences and why?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination for a Non-Resident Ambassador to the Republic of the Philippines (Constitution Article 115(d) and Foreign Service Act, Law No. 20/2021, Article 14) is sent to the relevant standing committee.
First reading of the Animal Husbandry and Animal Welfare Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Hinnavaru MP Mohamed Abdul Rahman.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's two nominations for Non-Resident Ambassadors to the Russian Federation and the Kingdom of Morocco.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to grill the Economic Minister in writing over the China-Maldives FTA, introduce the Animal Welfare Bill, and take up ambassador nominations for the Philippines, Russia and Morocco.
